entities.summary: Reynold Tala Maualuga is an American former professional football player who was a linebacker in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the USC Trojans, and was recognized as a unanimous All-American. He was selected by the Cincinnati Bengals in the second round of the 2009 NFL draft. He also played for the Miami Dolphins.
